issues.description: Requested output columns for Aufgabe 01 (Schwimmbad): the problem statement asks for ID, Name, Art and URL. The template query uses SELECT * (which would include the ID). The solution query (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql) selects only name, art, url and omits the ID column. This mismatch between the problem requirement and the provided solution can confuse students about whether the ID column is required and may cause correct student answers to be judged inconsistent with the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the requirement and the reference solution consistent. Either (A) update the solution to include the ID column explicitly, e.g. "SELECT id, name, art, url FROM Schwimmbad WHERE art='Freibad'", or (B) change the problem statement to remove the ID from the required output if the ID was not intended to be returned. Ensure the exact column name/case for the ID matches the schema (e.g. "id" vs "ID").
